data.narrative:
SpaceX operates in the Space & Aerospace sector at IPO stage. The comparable universe consists of 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private companies including Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, and Impulse Space.

Two standard valuation triangulation methods are not applicable to this analysis. Peer-Median methodology cannot be deployed because the narrow peer set in Space & Aerospace lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—only 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, and 0 similar-tier datapoints were identified among the 13 same-sector peers. Public-Comp Anchoring is also inapplicable because SpaceX's revenue is not disclosed, preventing calculation against the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 26.4x observed across the 6-ticker public comp set. Attempting a sector-wide median would introduce unacceptable noise given SpaceX's scale and business profile divergence from peers.

Without applicable quantitative triangulation methods, no valuation range can be supported by this analysis. The current stated valuation of $1.65T reflects cumulative investor capital deployment of $86B but requires alternative approaches—such as DCF modeling, transaction comparables, or strategic buyer pricing—to validate. Key uncertainties include revenue generation timing and trajectory, the appropriate discount rate for frontier aerospace ventures, and how public market multiples will anchor at IPO.
